title: OpenVA Agent Enrichment Row
description: The shared, transport-neutral vendor-identity row. This is the contract genuinely common to both enrichment surfaces: the MCP enrich_inventory tool wraps a list of these rows under `rows`, and the match-service /v1/enrich HTTP endpoint wraps the same rows under `vendors`. A row carries only bounded vendor-identity fields and an opaque row_id; additionalProperties is false so unrelated workspace columns cannot enter OpenVA. At least one identity field must be non-empty (enforced by each transport).

row_id.description: Opaque caller correlation id. Echoed verbatim; never interpreted as a workspace identifier.

registration_number.description: Matched via legal-entity resolution on any surface that carries legal-entity data for the vendor (the match service over a catalogue pack; the MCP snapshot over the vendor export's legal_entities) using one shared fallback. The shipped catalogue carries no legal-entity records yet, so a registration-number-only row currently resolves to no_match until such data exists.
